children.desc: Salamandrina perspicillata, the northern spectacled salamander, is a species of salamander in the family Salamandridae found only in Italy.
Salamandrina, the spectacled salamanders, is a genus of salamander, the only of subfamily Salamandrininae in the family Salamandridae which is still alive, as one of its own relatives is extinct.
subfamily of amphibians

desc: Salamandridae is a family of salamanders consisting of true salamanders and newts.
